name: web_search
description: Search the web with Tavily and return ranked results: titles, URLs, and content excerpts. Narrow with domains or recency, or ask for full page text. Use it for current information beyond the workspace.

include_answer.description: Include a short synthesized answer. Defaults to true.

search_depth.description: Retrieval depth. Use advanced for harder questions. Defaults to basic.

time_range.description: Limit results to a recent period, such as week.

days.description: Limit news results to the last N days.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains, such as docs.example.com.

include_raw_content.description: Return the full page text of each result instead of only an excerpt. Defaults to false.
